simple.meaning: צָהַל (tsâhal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to gleam , i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful ; by transference to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 10 times across Esther, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Esther 8:15. Its contexts include family line, kingship, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָהַל (H6670).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: צָהַל (tsâhal) / H6670 is traced through Esther 8:15, Psalms 104:15, Isaiah 10:30, Isaiah 12:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.
